summary_en: FY2026 dividend raised to ¥135/share from ¥95 estimate. Composition: ¥95 ordinary + ¥40 special. Prior year FY2025 was ¥110 (¥65 ordinary + ¥45 special). Increase driven by revenue outperformance and improved construction profit margins.
title_en: Notice regarding revision to dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Akatsuki Eazima issued a dividend revision notice on 29 June 2026 following a board resolution on 26 June. The company raised its full-year dividend forecast for FY2026 (year ending 31 August 2026) to ¥135 per share from the prior estimate of ¥95. The revised payout consists of ¥95 in ordinary dividend and ¥40 in special dividend. The prior fiscal year (FY2025) paid ¥110 total (¥65 ordinary plus ¥45 special). The company attributed the increase to revenue tracking above prior expectations and improved construction profit margins achieved through enhanced cost management. The company positions shareholder profit distribution as a core management priority, allocating returns based on business performance.
